test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Scholars have / studied the lives of / present-day farmer's / who practise agriculture.
solution:
The correct answer is **present-day farmer's.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment that contains a grammatical error is** present-day farmer's.**
 
• In this sentence, **the farmer **word should be in plural form.
 
• Thus the correct part of the sentence would be present-day farmers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When to add an "s" or "es" to a plural word. In English, we typically add an "s" to a word to make it plural. But occasionally, we add an "es." 
 
• When the noun is singular and we want to show that that noun owns something we add the apostrophe 's'.
 
 
• ​Example- The cat's toy is that.
 
 
 
• When a noun ends in s and is already plural, the apostrophe is placed after the s.
 
 
• Example- The cats' toy is that.
